summary: Iteration 2: full backend + frontend testing of new booking form, chat lead capture, and OG share tags. All 11 pytest cases pass. SSE chat stream returns {done:true, lead_form:true} for pricing/booking questions and lead_form:false for unrelated ones; literal [[LEAD_FORM]] marker never leaks. OG + Twitter meta tags all present with absolute https URLs and 1200x630 dimensions; /og-image.jpg returns 200 image/jpeg (120KB). Frontend: hero-primary-cta and nav-link-booking smoothly scroll to booking-section (Lenis, ~2s). Booking happy path: form submits, booking-success renders with 'Request received.' + visitor name & email echoed; email_sent true on backend. Chat lead capture: pricing question causes chat-lead-card to render (<60s), no marker leak. Chat lead POST hit the expected 5/10min rate-limit (429) and the UI showed a graceful 'Too many requests. Please try again later.' message (chat-lead-error testid) — this verifies the rate-limiter end-to-end rather than a bug. Mobile 390x844: zero horizontal overflow, booking form fully usable.
critical_code_review_comments: Rate limit of 5/10min per IP is tight for shared/NATed office IPs — consider 10/10min or per-session for production, but acceptable for current demo scope.
Chat lead card error UX is good (friendly 'Too many requests' copy). Consider adding retry-after countdown from the 429 Retry-After header if backend sets one.
test_credentials: N/A (no auth). Used delivered@resend.dev as visitor email per instructions.
seed_data_creation: pytest created leads with name 'Pytest Visitor' and 'Chat Lead' (both delivered@resend.dev) and self-deleted their chat sessions. UI created 1 booking lead ('UI Test Visitor') and 1 chat lead attempt (429, no row). 4 real owner emails sent to yogeshtrivedica@gmail.com — within the ~4-5 cap main agent requested.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Rate limit is 5 POST /api/leads per IP per 10 min and is shared between pytest + UI runs. If re-running within the window the UI chat-lead-submit will show 'Too many requests.' error — that is correct behavior, not a bug. SSE lead_form flag is reliable; chat replies 5-25s. OG tags live in /app/frontend/public/index.html with absolute REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL-based image URL.
